songs.description: “Stay” is an emotional ballad by Rihanna featuring Mikky Ekko, released as part of her album Unapologetic. Built around a minimal piano-driven arrangement, the song explores vulnerability, longing, emotional dependence, and the uncertainty of an intense relationship. Rihanna and Mikky Ekko’s restrained vocal performances give the track an intimate and reflective atmosphere, emphasizing the conflict between wanting emotional closeness and fearing the complications that come with it.
